title: Icon for `st.metric`
body: ### Checklist - [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. ### Summary Add an `icon` parameter to `st.metric` to show icons like in these dashboards: ### Why? Nice to quickly visualize what a metric is about. ### How? Not sure about the exact design. Should we have a border around it? Or maybe even a light background color? Or a parameter to set the color and background color? Also need to see how this looks together with sparkline charts. ### Additional Context _No response_
